question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Verify the ordering - check top 5 to make sure 3rd is clearly separated from 4th
WITH last_race_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(round) as max_round
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
last_races AS (
    SELECT r.race_id, r.year
    FROM races r
    JOIN last_race_per_year lry ON r.year = lry.year AND r.round = lry.max_round
),
constructor_season AS (
    SELECT lr.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_races lr ON cs.race_id = lr.race_id
),
driver_season AS (
    SELECT lr.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points as driver_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_races lr ON ds.race_id = lr.race_id
),
best_driver AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, driver_id
    FROM team_driver_ranks
    WHERE CAST(team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) = '1'
)
SELECT 
    c.name as constructor_name,
    cs.year,
    cs.constructor_points + ds.driver_points as combined_points
FROM constructor_season cs
JOIN best_driver bd ON cs.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id AND cs.year = bd.year
JOIN driver_season ds ON bd.driver_id = ds.driver_id AND bd.year = ds.year
JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 5
